labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Zen Browser is a free and open-source fork of Mozilla Firefox with a focus on privacy, customizability and design.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Zen

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG ZEN_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=Zen \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/zen-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y \
    xz-utils && \
  if [ -z ${ZEN_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    ZEN_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/zen-browser/desktop/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/zen.tar.xz -L \
    "https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/releases/download/${ZEN_VERSION}/zen.linux-x86_64.tar.xz" && \
  mkdir -p /opt/zen && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/zen.tar.xz -C \
    /opt/zen/ --strip-components=1 && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001
VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-123/

## New Features
- Updated to Firefox 159.0.1
- New grain options have been added to the theme picker. You can cycle through different grain effects by clicking on the circle inside the dial.

## Fixes
- Fixed a command prompt window briefly appearing on Windows when Zen restarts to apply an update.
- Fixed passkey sign-in failing on websites that share passkeys across related sites, such as Facebook and Instagram.
- Fixed crashes on Windows that could occur with some antivirus or other security software installed, in some cases also leaving WebGL disabled.
- Fixed red and blue colors appearing swapped on some websites that use WebGL on Linux, including video call background effects.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

## Changes
- On macOS, icons on the UI will now start using SF Symbols.
- The 'About Zen' window has been redesigned.
- 'My Review Request' option for Pull Requests live folder now searches for 'user-review-requested:@me' instead of 'review-requested:@me'
